title: Closed maximal-rank kernel locus of one finite-free sheaf map
statement: Let $X$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum], let $M,N$ be structure-sheaf modules, and let $d:M\to N$ be a module-sheaf morphism. Suppose $M\cong\mathcal O_X^{\oplus s}$ and $N\cong\mathcal O_X^{\oplus n}$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module], where $s,n,r\in\mathbf N$ and $s\le r$. There is a closed immersion $i:Z\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], such that for every scheme $T$ and morphism $h:T\to X$, $h$ factors through $i$ if and only if the kernel of the ordinary pulled-back morphism $h^*d:h^*M\to h^*N$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is finite locally free of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module].

source.place: local matrix calculation in the proof, using Tag 0EWY; the smaller-domain case uses padding as in the parent node

proof.text: Transfer the supplied finite free frames along arbitrary pullback using pullbackFreeIso. Apply the kernel criterion on the source of the pullback.
If s=r, use the affine finite-free map zero locus. Its universal property and the kernel criterion identify factorizations exactly with rank-r locally free kernels.

If s<r, use the empty scheme with its unique map to X, which is a closed immersion and locally of finite presentation. The kernel criterion says the desired rank condition holds exactly when the source is empty. An empty source factors by initiality, while a factor through the empty scheme forces the source to be empty.

proof_origin.note: Fully proved in Lean from existing constructions and Mathlib; strict rank uses the injective free-module rank inequality.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affineFreeKernelRankLocus
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X]
    (M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (X.ringCatSheaf)) (d : M ⟶ N)
    (s n r : ℕ) (hsr : s ≤ r)
    (hM : Nonempty (M ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (hN : Nonempty (N ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := X.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)))) :
    ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ X),
      IsClosedImmersion i ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation i ∧
      (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (h : T ⟶ X),
        (∃ g : T ⟶ Z, g ≫ i = h) ↔
          SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
            (kernel ((Modules.pullback h).map d)) r)
